description.en: Complete LAN/remote access for the Web UI: 0.0.0.0 binding, crypto.randomUUID polyfill, token gate (401 login page + WebSocket interception, loopback exempt), privileged-fence and settings-persistence exemptions, and an idempotent installer with upgrade recovery.
description.zh: Web UI 完整局域网/远程访问：0.0.0.0 绑定、crypto.randomUUID polyfill、token 门禁（401 登录页 + WebSocket 拦截，环回地址豁免）、特权栅栏与设置持久化豁免，以及可幂等升级恢复的安装器。
